home.intro: I've loved computers for as long as I can remember, and over the years it became my job. Away from the screen, you'll find me on my bike or surrounded by cats :)

story.p1: I'm 20 years old and I'm from Medellín. Computers have been with me for many years, and over time that curiosity became the path I want to follow.

path.title: How I started
path.text: I started in web development with a pretty simple curiosity: I wanted to understand how the things I saw on the internet were built. My first contact with computing was studying a Systems Technician program at SENA. The more I learned, the more I wanted to understand what was behind it all: how systems connect and what happens to information. That curiosity led me to take my first steps as a backend developer.
